reviews.title: Worst metronome app ever!
reviews.text: This app is more user unfriendly than the school bully. It is not intuitive, not easy to learn, and basically sucks at every level of frustration it engenders. I wish I could be paid for the hours I’ve wasted trying to figure out its arcane, ill-conceived architecture. Save your money and reject this horrible excuse for an app.

reviews.title: Major improvements needed!
reviews.text: BEWARE! NOT user friendly! Not intuitive. You must first set a BPM, then create your song title for a set list. If you forget to set the BPM, you have to delete the song and do it again. Also, you can’t edit the song title, BPM, or reorder the songs on your Setlist after you’ve created it. So if you need to move song # 5, for example, in your song list, or rename it, etc., you’re screwed. You must build a whole new playlist. Very disappointing, only finding out after paying for the app.
